transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, what really scared me enough to come in today is something that's been happening at work. I work as a surveillance officer, and lately, during the quiet stretches in the monitor room, I keep hearing voices coming through the speakers. 

They say things to me like, You missed it, Ruth, or, People are going to get hurt because of you. But the thing is... every single channel is muted when this happens. And I know no one else in the room hears anything at all. It just really spooked me, so I knew I needed to see someone.
About how long ago did you first start hearing these voices?
It's been... I'd say about four months now. It started right around the time I was moved into the lead casino surveillance role.
During these past four months, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed?

Yes, I have. Most days, it feels like this... heavy gray mood just settles over me before I even get out of bed in the morning. And it just stays with me. I'll find myself tearing up in my car before my shift starts, over nothing more than just seeing the casino lights. So, yeah, I've been feeling very down.
Have you ever heard these voices during a time when you weren't feeling down or depressed?

No, I haven't. Before this whole stretch of feeling so hopeless and guilty—which really started after that surveillance lead change—I had never heard accusations coming through the equipment. And I never felt so certain that I was dangerous to everyone, either. The voices and those beliefs... they really only seem to be a part of this same low period. I never had them before I started feeling this down.
Have you ever experienced a period in your life where you felt unusually energized, wired, or on top of the world, needing very little sleep?

No, I haven't. I've never really had a time like that. I don't think I've ever felt... on top of the world, or wired. I usually need my regular amount of sleep to function, so, no, I haven't experienced anything like what you're describing.
Have you been using any recreational drugs or substances over the past few months?
No, I haven't. I don't use any recreational drugs. I just... I don't do that kind of thing. I might have a drink every now and then, but nothing else.
Do you have any medical conditions, or have you recently had any new physical illnesses or head injuries?
No, I don't. I don't have any medical conditions that I know of. And I haven't been sick lately... no head injuries or anything like that. Physically, I've been fine.
